s: Shello lishtot achar arba kosot ubo b' seipim: achar d' kosot nahagu kol yisrael middorot harishonim shello lishtot yayin o shear mashqeh hamshakker, lepi shechayyab adam laasoq kol hallayla behilkot pesach ubitziat mitzrayim ulesapper benissim veniplaot sheasa haqqadosh baruk hu laabotenu ad shettachtepennu shena, veim yehe muttar lo lishtot — yesh lachosh shemma yishtakker velo yaasoq visapper kelal. Abal leachar shechatapto shena — muttar lo lishtot. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shemmeiqqar haddin asur lishtot kol mashqeh, kede shello yaabor mippiv taam matztza shel haapiqoman, chutz mimmayim vekayyotze bahem, kegon me zangebil (sheqqorin ainagabar voashar), ume shoresh (sheqqorin laqaritz), ume tappuchim (sheqqorin apil taranaq) shemmebashshelim mayim im tappuchim, abal apil taranaq sheosin beashkenaz shekkoteshin hattappuchim bebet habbad veyesh lo taam gadol — eno kemayim, veasur lishtot. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem im lo letzorek harbeh, kegon shehu istenis o shettaeb harbeh lishtot — yesh lismok al sebara harishona lehattir lo lishtot shear hammashqin sheenan meshakkerin. Veim en lo shear mashqin raq yayin — yesh lehattir lo lishtot kos chamishi velomar alayv hallel haggadol ve"nishmat" ve"yishtabbach" ad hachatima, vehu shello yomrem al kos rebii. Ubelel b' — yesh lismok al sebara harishona lishtot kol hammashqin sheenan meshakkerin ap shello letzorek harbeh, lepi shemmeiqqar haddin en issur leekol velishtot belel b' achar kos shelishi veachar kos rebii. Ella shehamhadderin nohagin lel b' kelel a', vehaokel vehashshoteh — en alayv kelum, ella shennimtza motzi atzmo mikkelal hamhadderin, veober al dibre chakamim sheameru: leolam al yotzi adam et atzmo min hakkelal. Abal bishar haddebarim hannohagin belayla zeh — en chilluq ben lel a' lelel b' beshum inyan:

Nohagin shello liqrot al mittato raq birkat "hammappil" uparashat "shema", shepparasha zo muzkeret baggemara, abal lo shear debarim shennohagin liqrot bishar lelot kede lehagen, ki layla zeh layla hamshummeret hi min hammazziqin. Umikkol maqom, im kesheqqara qeriat shema bebet hakkeneset lo haya adayin layla mammash — tzarik lachazor veliqrot kol hag' parashiyyot al mittato, kemo shennitbaer besiman rl"h ayyen sham:
